tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy, from the official logo files (Mono Navy). Used for text, never as a page or card background.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Action colour: button fills, icons and small highlights. A brighter step of the brand orange, chosen by Radhika for buttons. Text on it is navy. Never used as text on white.

tokens.name: orange-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for anything orange. Hover always deepens the orange; it never turns dark, black or navy.

tokens.name: burnt
tokens.usage: Burnt orange from the official logo shading. Links and small text highlights on white.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Cream highlight from the official logo. Small accents and illustration only, never a large surface.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Official brand orange from the logo files (Mono Orange, orange avatar). For the logo, avatar and brand moments; buttons use the brighter orange token.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Always white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles and large blocks on the white page.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: A second grey for nested surfaces or image placeholders inside a surface.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Strongest grey: input borders, dividers that must be visible, disabled fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rules, nav underline, secondary button outline.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All headings and body text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels on bg and surface (6.8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on orange or orange-hover.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline text links on white.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px with a 3px offset.
